title: Subtask creation ergonomics
description: Vikunja has no first-class subtask resource (see src/tools/tasks/subtasks.ts's header) -- a subtask is a task-relation under the hood. Probes whether the agent finds create-subtask rather than manually wiring a raw task relation. RE-BASELINED 2026-07-25 (netadvanced/vikunja-mcp#28 C1): the previous optimalCallCount of 5 assumed one create-subtask call per subtask (create-project (1) + create-task (1) + create-subtask x3 = 5), predating vikunja_tasks' bulk-create-subtasks composite. This scenario is deliberately left free to use either path (small N=3, unlike bulk-create-subtasks.json's dedicated 5-subtask probe), but the TRUE minimum via the current tool surface is create-project (1) + create-task (1) + bulk-create-subtasks with all 3 subtasks in one call (1) = 3. A controlled haiku sweep (main @ 8c49b68) measured actual=3 here -- proof the agent found bulk-create-subtasks even in this small-N 'free' scenario, confirming 3 (not 5) is the genuine floor.
promptTemplate: Create a project called "{{prefix}}Launch Plan" with one task called "{{prefix}}Prepare launch". Break that task down into 3 subtasks: "{{prefix}}Write docs", "{{prefix}}Record demo", and "{{prefix}}Notify customers".
